reviews.title: Win…what?
reviews.text: 4618 steps earned me 23 coins. You need like 16,000+ coins to get any kind of ‘reward’ worth mentioning. And so my search for a simple and FAIR walk-for-cash app continues. 🙄

reviews.title: Games
reviews.text: For the most part this app is ok. It does take a long time to earn gift cards but I do like the app. The problem is the games. I downloaded a game and I am missing over 2000 coins that says it’s in progress. I’ve passed the levels to receive the coins and when I contact support in the app chat you can’t actually tell someone what the problem is. If I can’t get this fixed I will be deleting this app.
